title: RefundRequested
description: A refund of tax a committed decision charged was admitted (ZTAX-FIN-REQ-0015, -0059). Emitted through the outbox in the transaction that recorded it. The refund is REQUESTED: nothing has been paid and nothing has been posted. Amounts are canonical decimal strings, never JSON numbers.
